title: Ref
description: Mutable named pointer { name, hash, version_constraint? } per spec.md §5.3 + ADR-0025.

name.description: Stable UTF-8 identifier. Path syntax per reel namespace rules.

version_constraint.description: Optional precondition for Class B commit gating (§5.7.2). null if Ref has no remote version semantics.

x-reel-status: v0.1 canonical (per ADR-0025). Replaces pre-ADR-0024 schema that had {id: UUIDv7, block_id, timestamp} — ADR-0025 makes `name` the identity.
